name: container
description: Centered, width-constrained page container with shared gutters and four width presets.
designIntent: Pages repeat the same mx-auto/max-w/px trio with slightly different values. Container makes the content width and gutters a shared decision so headers, marketing sections and app pages line up.

props.name: width
props.description: Maximum content width. lg is 80rem (1280px); xl is 1400px; full removes the cap.

props.name: padding
props.description: Horizontal gutters. md is px-4 / sm:px-6; lg adds lg:px-8.

examples.title: Page container
examples.description: Shared width and gutters for a page header and its content.

antiPatterns.title: Don't nest same-width containers
antiPatterns.explanation: A Container inside a Container doubles the gutters on narrow screens. Use Section's inner container once.

accessibility.userRequirements: Use a landmark element when the container is a page region and give it an accessible name

compositionRules.relationship: Section renders a Container internally; use Container directly only for custom chrome

files.content:
export { Container } from './Container';
export type { ContainerProps, ContainerWidth } from './Container';

{
  "id": "container",
  "name": "Container",
  "tier": "atom",
  "package": "@slipstream-ui/core",
  "importPath": "@slipstream-ui/core",
  "version": "0.8.0",
  "sourceDir": "container",
  "exportName": "Container",
  "description": "Centered, width-constrained page container with shared gutters and four width presets.",
  "designIntent": "Pages repeat the same mx-auto/max-w/px trio with slightly different values. Container makes the content width and gutters a shared decision so headers, marketing sections and app pages line up.",
  "props": [
    {
      "name": "width",
      "type": "'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | 'full'",
      "required": false,
      "defaultValue": "lg",
      "enum": [
        "sm",
        "md",
        "lg",
        "xl",
        "full"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum content width. lg is 80rem (1280px); xl is 1400px; full removes the cap."
    },
    {
      "name": "padding",
      "type": "'none' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'",
      "required": false,
      "defaultValue": "md",
      "enum": [
        "none",
        "sm",
        "md",
        "lg"
      ],
      "description": "Horizontal gutters. md is px-4 / sm:px-6; lg adds lg:px-8."
    },
    {
      "name": "as",
      "type": "'div' | 'section' | 'article' | 'header' | 'footer' | 'main' | 'nav'",
      "required": false,
      "defaultValue": "div",
      "description": "Semantic element to render."
    }
  ],
  "examples": [
    {
      "title": "Page container",
      "code": "<Container width=\"lg\" padding=\"lg\">\n  <PageHeader title=\"Deals\" />\n</Container>",
      "description": "Shared width and gutters for a page header and its content."
    }
  ],
  "antiPatterns": [
    {
      "title": "Don't nest same-width containers",
      "explanation": "A Container inside a Container doubles the gutters on narrow screens. Use Section's inner container once.",
      "example": "// Avoid\n<Container><Container>Content</Container></Container>"
    }
  ],
  "accessibility": [
    {
      "feature": "Semantic element",
      "implementation": "The as prop renders div/section/article/header/footer/main/nav",
      "userRequirements": "Use a landmark element when the container is a page region and give it an accessible name"
    }
  ],
  "compositionRules": [
    {
      "component": "Section",
      "relationship": "Section renders a Container internally; use Container directly only for custom chrome",
      "example": "<Section width=\"lg\"><Hero /></Section>"
    }
  ],
  "relatedComponents": [
    "Section",
    "Block",
    "Grid"
  ]
}
